scanner_notes: wizcli binary present at /opt/homebrew/bin/wizcli but WIZ_CLIENT_ID / WIZ_CLIENT_SECRET not set in environment. Fallback: npm audit for dependency CVEs + manual OWASP-Top-10 review of feature diff. To run full Wiz scan: wizcli scan dir srcV2/ --stdout json --json-output-file docs/security/wiz-edit-existing-infra-ui-path-wiz.json --no-publish (requires WIZ_CLIENT_ID + WIZ_CLIENT_SECRET).
gate_rationale: Zero critical findings introduced by this feature. Two pre-existing npm critical advisories (vitest GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp) are devDependencies absent from the production Docker image (Stage 2 uses npm ci --only=production). These are carryover findings tracked in wiz-service-catalog-prefill-report.json.

pre_existing_criticals.title: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary file can be read and executed
pre_existing_criticals.rationale: Dockerfile Stage 2 uses 'npm ci --only=production'; vitest absent from production container

code_review.method: Manual OWASP-Top-10 review of feature diff (InstalledAppsPage.vue, navigation.ts, CustomInfrastructurePage.vue, AppSelector.vue, routes/api.js)

xss.notes: No v-html directives in new code. All data bound via Vue template auto-escaping.

injection.notes: appName/environment validated client-side with /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/ regex in CustomInfrastructurePage.vue (line 660-661) before API call. Backend enforces tighter /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,8}$/ on appName and environment allowlist from data/environments.json.

broken_auth.notes: GET /api/app-metadata/:appName/:env has requireAuth middleware. No auth bypass introduced.

sensitive_data_exposure.notes: No secrets or PII introduced. prefillContext only holds appName + environment (non-sensitive). Context cleared immediately after consumption (line 664, 672).

hardcoded_secrets.notes: No hardcoded credentials in new files. VITE_ENABLE_CATALOG_PREFILL is a build-time env var (VITE_ prefix), not set in Dockerfile.

context_leak.notes: prefillContext.value set to null on both success and failure paths in onMounted (FR-004 / NFR-004). navigateToPage() without context sets prefillContext.value = null (navigation.ts line 29).

dockerfile_review.notes: COPY . . in Stage 1 captures srcV2/. npm run build:client produces dist/. COPY --from=frontend-builder /app/dist ./dist in Stage 2. VITE_ENABLE_CATALOG_PREFILL must be injected via CI build-arg at image build time (e.g., --build-arg VITE_ENABLE_CATALOG_PREFILL=true).

next_action: Run full wizcli scan in CI pipeline with WIZ_CLIENT_ID + WIZ_CLIENT_SECRET set as GitHub Actions secrets before promoting to prod. Upgrade vitest >= 4.1.8 to resolve pre-existing devDependency criticals.
